title: Mussolini's Fascists march on Rome
summary: Thousands of Fascist Blackshirts converged on Rome, and King Victor Emmanuel III refused to declare martial law and soon asked Benito Mussolini to form a government.
reason: Postwar unrest, fear of socialism and a weak liberal state let the Fascists present themselves as a force for order.
significance: It brought the first fascist government to power in Europe.
